question: List the names of orchestras that have no performance.
selected_sql: SELECT Orchestra FROM orchestra WHERE Orchestra_ID NOT IN (SELECT Orchestra_ID FROM performance);
gold_query1: select orchestra from orchestra where orchestra_id not in (select orchestra_id from recital)
gold_query2: select orchestra from orchestra where orchestra_id not in (select orchestra_id from concert)

question: List all singer names in concerts in year 2014.
selected_sql: SELECT singer.Name FROM singer JOIN singer_in_concert ON singer.Singer_ID = singer_in_concert.Singer_ID JOIN concert ON singer_in_concert.concert_ID = concert.concert_ID WHERE concert.Year = '2014';
gold_query1: select t2.name from singer_in_concert as t1 join singer as t2 on t1.singer_id = t2.singer_id join gig as t3 on t1.concert_id = t3.concert_id where t3.year = 2014
gold_query2: select t2.name from singer_in_concert as t1 join singer as t2 on t1.singer_id = t2.singer_id join performance as t3 on t1.concert_id = t3.concert_id where t3.year = 2014

question: What are the date and the operating professional's first name of each treatment?
selected_sql: SELECT T2.date_of_treatment, T1.first_name FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id
gold_query1: select t1.date_of_treatment, t2.forename from treatments as t1 join professionals as t2 on t1.professional_id = t2.professional_id
gold_query2: select t1.date_of_treatment, t2.given_name from treatments as t1 join professionals as t2 on t1.professional_id = t2.professional_id

question: What are the different government forms and what is the total population of each for government forms that have an average life expectancy greater than 72?
selected_sql: SELECT GovernmentForm, SUM(Population) AS TotalPopulation FROM country WHERE LifeExpectancy > 72 GROUP BY GovernmentForm
gold_query1: select sum(population), governmentform from nation group by governmentform having avg(lifeexpectancy) > 72
gold_query2: select sum(population), governmentform from state group by governmentform having avg(lifeexpectancy) > 72

question: What are the different models created by either the car maker General Motors or weighed more than 3500?
gold_query1: select distinct t2.model from car_names as t1 join car_models as t2 on t1.model = t2.model join car_makers as t3 on t2.maker = t3.id join cars_data as t4 on t1.makeid = t4.id where t3.fullname = 'General Motors' or t4.weight > 3500
gold_query2: select distinct t2.model from car_names as t1 join vehicle_models as t2 on t1.model = t2.model join car_makers as t3 on t2.maker = t3.id join cars_data as t4 on t1.makeid = t4.id where t3.fullname = 'General Motors' or t4.weight > 3500

question: Which owners live in the state whose name contains the substring 'North'? List his first name, last name and email.
selected_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, email_address FROM Owners WHERE state LIKE '%North%';
gold_query1: select first_name, surname, email_address from owners where state like '%North%'
gold_query2: select first_name, family_name, email_address from owners where state like '%North%'

question: Return the ids of templates that have the code PP or PPT.
selected_sql: SELECT Template_ID FROM Templates WHERE Template_Type_Code IN ('PP', 'PPT');
gold_query1: select template_id from forms where template_type_code = "PP" or template_type_code = "PPT"
gold_query2: select template_id from drafts where template_type_code = "PP" or template_type_code = "PPT"

question: Show names of teachers and the courses they are arranged to teach.
selected_sql: SELECT teacher.Name AS Teacher_Name, course.Course AS Course_Name FROM teacher JOIN course_arrange ON teacher.Teacher_ID = course_arrange.Teacher_ID JOIN course ON course_arrange.Course_ID = course.Course_ID
gold_query1: select t3.name, t2.course from course_arrange as t1 join course as t2 on t1.course_id = t2.course_id join instructor as t3 on t1.teacher_id = t3.teacher_id
gold_query2: select t3.name, t2.course from course_arrange as t1 join course as t2 on t1.course_id = t2.course_id join professor as t3 on t1.teacher_id = t3.teacher_id

question: Find the production code and channel of the most recently aired cartoon.
selected_sql: SELECT Production_code, Channel FROM Cartoon ORDER BY Original_air_date DESC LIMIT 1;
gold_query1: select production_number, channel from cartoon order by original_air_date limit 1
gold_query2: select episode_code, channel from cartoon order by original_air_date limit 1

question: How many matches were played in each year?
selected_sql: SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM matches GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;
gold_query1: select count(*), year from games group by year
gold_query2: select count(*), year from contests group by year

question: What is the most populace city that speaks English?
selected_sql: SELECT c.Name AS CityName, MAX(c.Population) AS Population FROM city c JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.CountryCode = cl.CountryCode WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T'
gold_query1: select t1.name, t1.total_inhabitants from city as t1 join countrylanguage as t2 on t1.countrycode = t2.countrycode where t2.language = "English" order by t1.total_inhabitants desc limit 1
gold_query2: select t1.name, t1.number_of_residents from city as t1 join countrylanguage as t2 on t1.countrycode = t2.countrycode where t2.language = "English" order by t1.number_of_residents desc limit 1

question: What is the name of the museum that had no visitor yet?
selected_sql: SELECT Name FROM museum WHERE Museum_ID NOT IN (SELECT Museum_ID FROM visit);
gold_query1: select title from museum where museum_id not in (select museum_id from visit)
gold_query2: select designation from museum where museum_id not in (select museum_id from visit)

question: Show ids for all templates that are used by more than one document.
selected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Template_ID FROM Documents WHERE Document_ID IN (SELECT Document_ID FROM Documents GROUP BY Document_ID HAVING COUNT(Template_ID) > 1)
gold_query1: select pattern_id from documents group by pattern_id having count(*) > 1
gold_query2: select form_id from documents group by form_id having count(*) > 1

question: Please show the name of the conductor that has conducted orchestras founded after 2008.
selected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.Name FROM conductor c JOIN orchestra o ON c.Conductor_ID = o.Conductor_ID WHERE o.Year_of_Founded > 2008;
gold_query1: select t1.full_name from conductor as t1 join orchestra as t2 on t1.conductor_id = t2.conductor_id where year_of_founded > 2008
gold_query2: select t1.title from conductor as t1 join orchestra as t2 on t1.conductor_id = t2.conductor_id where year_of_founded > 2008

question: What are the names of players who won in both 2013 and 2016?
selected_sql: SELECT winner_name FROM matches WHERE YEAR = 2013 INTERSECT SELECT winner_name FROM matches WHERE YEAR = 2016
gold_query1: select winning_player_name from matches where year = 2013 intersect select winning_player_name from matches where year = 2016
gold_query2: select victorious_player_name from matches where year = 2013 intersect select victorious_player_name from matches where year = 2016

question: What is the total number of people living in the nations that do not use English?
selected_sql: SELECT SUM(Population) AS TotalPopulation FROM country WHERE Code NOT IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'English');
gold_query1: select sum(population) from nation where name not in (select t1.name from nation as t1 join countrylanguage as t2 on t1.code = t2.countrycode where t2.language = "English")
gold_query2: select sum(population) from state where name not in (select t1.name from state as t1 join countrylanguage as t2 on t1.code = t2.countrycode where t2.language = "English")

question: What is the horsepower of the car with the greatest accelerate?
selected_sql: SELECT Horsepower FROM cars_data ORDER BY Accelerate DESC LIMIT 1
gold_query1: select t1.power from cars_data as t1 order by t1.accelerate desc limit 1
gold_query2: select t1.torque from cars_data as t1 order by t1.accelerate desc limit 1

question: For each semester, what is the name and id of the one with the most students registered?
selected_sql: SELECT semester_id, semester_name FROM Semesters WHERE semester_id = (SELECT semester_id FROM Student_Enrolment GROUP BY semester_id ORDER BY COUNT(student_id) DESC LIMIT 1);
gold_query1: select t1.semester_name, t1.semester_id from academic_terms as t1 join student_enrolment as t2 on t1.semester_id = t2.semester_id group by t1.semester_id order by count(*) desc limit 1
gold_query2: select t1.semester_name, t1.semester_id from enrollment_periods as t1 join student_enrolment as t2 on t1.semester_id = t2.semester_id group by t1.semester_id order by count(*) desc limit 1

question: Show the names of conductors that have conducted more than one orchestras.
selected_sql: SELECT Name FROM conductor WHERE Conductor_ID IN (SELECT Conductor_ID FROM orchestra GROUP BY Conductor_ID HAVING COUNT(Orchestra_ID) > 1)
gold_query1: select t1.name from conductor as t1 join ensemble as t2 on t1.conductor_id = t2.conductor_id group by t2.conductor_id having count(*) > 1
gold_query2: select t1.name from conductor as t1 join symphony as t2 on t1.conductor_id = t2.conductor_id group by t2.conductor_id having count(*) > 1

question: What are all the possible breed type and size type combinations?
selected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.breed_name AS breed_type, s.size_description AS size_type FROM Breeds b JOIN Dogs d ON b.breed_code = d.breed_code JOIN Sizes s ON d.size_code = s.size_code LIMIT 100;
gold_query1: select distinct race_code, size_code from dogs
gold_query2: select distinct pedigree_code, size_code from dogs
